zone.description: The managed zone that contains the name

allowed.description: Whether the caller may use the zone at all: always true for administrators, for a module whether its policy has a rule for it

access.description: What the caller may do in the zone: 'write' when some write rule covers it (whatever names and types it allows), 'read' when only read rules do, 'none' otherwise. Always 'write' for administrators; 'none' for a name in no managed zone

full.description: Whether the caller may change every name and type in the zone (a write rule with names '*' and types '*'). Always true for administrators when the zone is managed

records.description: Present when the input listed records: for each, in the same order, whether the caller may read it (get-records shows it) and change it. A record outside the zone, or in no managed zone, is neither
